title: Hypernormalisation | Full Documentary | Adam Curtis
summary: Adam Curtis's 2016 BBC documentary arguing that politicians, financiers and technologists retreated into a simplified, fake version of the world because reality became too complex. It ranges across Trump, Brexit, Syria, Surkov's Russia and more.
why: HN points to it for its account of propaganda that sows distrust and confusion, and as a starting point for Adam Curtis's work.

quote.text: Adam Curtis is great, definitely check out his other work.
